Method of Attack: Screenlocker with 10 minutes countdown to enter a code or it deletes contents of drives
Copies itself to %UserProfile%\AppData\Local\stalin.exe and creates autorun entry
Creates fl.dat to track countdown time
Terminates processes except Skype and Discord
Attempts to create Scheduled Task 'Driver Update' to launch Stalin.exe
Deletes all files on accessible drives from A to Z if code not entered
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user profile directories
Attack Vector: Execution of StalinLocker executable on Windows system
